title: Austin's Civic Center Plans & Procurement Delay
summary:
*   **Civic Center Site Discussion:** The primary focus of the meeting was a work session on potential locations for a new civic center, with consultants providing a detailed discussion.
*   **Minority Procurement Report Postponed:** The City Council did not take up the City Manager's report regarding minority procurement initiatives.
*   **Committee Appointments Delayed:** A resolution concerning the appointment of members to the Select Committee on Services and Spending was not addressed.

Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of the Council* noting the
absence of Councilmember Urdy.
A work session was held on civic center site location. Jim Goluska and Bryan Bochner of
Skidmore, Owings and Merrill discussed the site with Council.
Council did not take up the City Manager report on Minority Procurement; nor the
resolution to consider appointment of members to the Select Committee on Services and
Spending; nor did they go into executive session.
Council adjourned:its meeting at 6:00 p.m.
